[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on taking the first step towards establishing a consistent morning routine on weekends.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips to establish a consistent wake-up time on weekends, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Set a realistic goal (wake up 30 minutes to 1 hour earlier).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Create a relaxing bedtime routine (reading, meditation, warm bath).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Establish a consistent sleep schedule (same time every day).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use a wake-up light or smart alarm clock.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Make a plan for the morning (exercise, breakfast, hobby).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Gradually adjust wake-up time (set alarm 15-30 minutes earlier).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Get some accountability (share goals with a friend or family member).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Reward yourself (treat for waking up on time).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Be kind to yourself (it's okay to have an off day).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Make it a habit (consistency for 3-4 weeks).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant reminded the user to be patient as their body adjusts to a new wake-up time.  
[EVENT] User mentioned struggling with screen time on Sundays.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant acknowledged the challenge of cutting down on screen time and provided tips, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Set a goal for specific screen time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Schedule screen-free time blocks.
